paper: Align, Don't Blend: Orthogonal Supervision Disentanglement As the Key to Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (Chen et al., ACM MM 2026, arXiv 2512.06746 v3)
training_set_in_paper: Not trained in SynthScope. Only the released VLM branch is evaluated: the official LoRA adapter Gaffeyzz/Align-Dont-Blend-VLM @ 49975ccd on Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct @ cc594898, inference only, the official greedy decoding, unparsed answers counted wrong (0 in every run); AUROC from the verdict-token logit gap at the word the official parser read (after <answer>, or the tag-less final line's verdict word for 446 of 23,981 per-image records), 0 unscored in every run. The paper's detector is the VLM branch OR the DDA pixel expert (the released DDA checkpoint, confirmed by the authors 2026-11-20): that full method is adb_full, whose reproduction is repro/benchmark_specs/adb_full.json. The paper prints no VLM-only number for the released adapter, so every row below is a reference for this branch, never a reproduction. Benchmark subsets and per-image results: repro/vlm_bench/ (comparison.json, vlms.adb_vlm and paper_comparison.adb_vlm).

benchmarks.name: WildRF (Facebook, Reddit, Twitter test sets), full data, 2,503 images
benchmarks.metric: balanced accuracy per platform, and their mean

paper_number.note: The paper prints no VLM-only number for the released adapter. Its full method (VLM OR the DDA pixel expert, adb_full), Table 1: 92.9 (Facebook 92.2 / Reddit 90.9 / Twitter 95.5); context only, not a target.

our_number.note: VLM branch alone, official adapter, greedy, full data: 93.98 balanced acc (Facebook 93.13 / Reddit 93.06 / Twitter 95.75), AUROC 98.78, 0 unparsed, 0 unscored (51 tag-less answers scored at their final line's verdict word). The paper prints no VLM-only number; its full method (VLM OR the DDA expert) prints 92.9, and adb_full gives 93.01 on the same images (91.22 with the f4b4794 request). These are different detectors, so this row is not a reproduction. Measured with the upstream f4b4794 request (before the cf168db sync); the cf168db VLM-alone numbers on the paper benchmarks are in models/image/adb_vlm/README.md.
